''See also: [[Penance Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Penance is a heavenly weapon of immense power, characterized as an absolute decree of death. It is described as a [[Monarch]]-killing tool that does not function through traditional physical impact; instead, it possesses the ability to decide the death of its target. When utilized in its true form, the weapon can strike down a [[Monarch]] instantly. The weapon is also capable of seeking out its prey and can be used to strike targets even without being launched from a bow. A significant history surrounds the creation of Penance. The [[Soulsmith]] Ozmanthus Arelius{{!}}Ozmanthus spent many years attempting to perfect this weapon as a means of atonement for his past failures, though he never successfully completed it. His various attempts and prototypes, such as improved arrowheads of death, have been found in different locations like [[Blackflame City]] and beneath Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius. While these earlier versions may not match the strength of the finished weapon, they remain highly valuable. In recent events, an [[Abidan]] gifted the true Penance to [[Yerin]], who later used it to strike a [[Monarch]]. Additionally, the weapon has been sought as a prize in competitions and viewed by some as a valuable asset for blackmail or intimidation.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Penance is a heavenly weapon and silver-edged black arrowhead that serves as a prize in a [[tournament]] contested by eight individuals. Capable of removing a [[Dreadgod]], this item is sought after by the [[Akura clan]] and [[dragons]] like [[Reigan Shen]], though its presence forces all competitors to follow the rules for the time being. The weapon acts as a deterrent against enemy [[Heralds]] attacking [[Fury]], and [[Eithan]] may even use it to blackmail [[Reigan Shen]]. Ultimately, the arrowhead is handed to [[Yerin]] by an [[Abidan]], carrying a sensation of death and finality. This tool has the power to prevent a [[dragon]] from becoming a [[Remnant]], kill Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara's great-grandfather, or be used as a [[technique]] against [[Akura Malice]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Originally offered by the [[Abidan]] as the prize for the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament, Penance is a unique, single-use arrowhead. When [[Mercy]] unleashed the attack, the arrow actively sought its intended prey and served as a grueling test of will for [[Lindon]]. The true nature of Penance does not rely on being shot from a bow or making physical contact, but instead functions as an absolute decree that decides who is dead. This power was so potent that Authority{{!}}authority from the weapon flowed through the cracks in [[Mercy]]'s [[madra channels]], eventually allowing [[Yerin]] to use it to strike down a [[Monarch]].}}
